title: Internal Linking for Programmatic Pages
meta_description: When you generate a thousand pages from a template the internal linking is the only thing that separates a useful section of the site from a doorway page farm, and most teams only work this out after the pages are already live and already ignored.
body_html: Template pages need links that vary with the data, not a fixed footer block repeated a thousand times.

title: Robots.txt Rules That Quietly Deindex Sites
meta_title: Robots.txt Rules That Quietly Deindex Sites
meta_description: A disallow line does not remove a page from the index. It removes Google's ability to see the noindex tag on it.
body_html: This is the single most common way a site loses its rankings during a migration.
